# About this work

This thesis studies **embedding** relations between *forcing* notions —
a central tool of modern set theory, introduced by Paul Cohen to settle
the independence of the continuum hypothesis.

The complete PDF (Spanish original) is available
[here](../pdf/ENCAJES_ENTRE_NOCIONES_DE_FORCING.pdf).

## Languages

The content is available in three languages:

- [**Español**](/) (original)
- **English** — current
- [**Français**](/fr/)

## Structure

Chapters will appear here as the original `.tex` manuscript is migrated and
translated.
